item.title: Why Maple Leafs GM Brad Treliving thinks Radko Gudas suspension was too short
item.description: Too lenient. Maple Leafs general manager Brad Treliving, to no one’s shock, thought the five-game suspension handed down to Anaheim Ducks defenceman Radko Gudas by the National Hockey League wasn’t long enough. item.title: SUNshine Girl Shaye
item.description: SUNshine Girl Shaye loves a good nap. The 6-foot-tall Sagittarius enjoys horseback riding. Her dream car is a Tesla. What music would she play while driving? That would be country all the way. Her dream job is to be a paramedic. She’s a fan of actor Chad Michael Murray. These photos were taken in March 2019. (Dave Abel/Toronto Sun)
